issues_outside_coverage: Conceded inclusion of $2,537 (DFAS) and $449 (US Security Associates) income excluded as foreign earned income (conceded, not decided)
decisive_judgment_findings: Petitioner's ties to Afghanistan were severely limited and transitory (confined to base, no property, bank account or family there), while his economic, familial and personal ties to the United States (Colorado home with wife and child, car, driver's license, bank accounts, voter registration) were predominant, so his abode was in the United States.
Petitioner made no reasonable attempt to comply, did little to no research, and showed no reliance on his preparer for advice on sec. 911.
Return filed January 22, 2016, more than three months after the extended due date of October 15, 2015, with no evidence of reasonable cause.
